comments.text: The evidence has entered the room.
That stack has developed a personality.
The arrow has changed its mind.
Another chance to make things click.
The future has declined to comment.
A neat finish for that hand.
The result is written in ink.
A pot with more than one destination.
The cards tell a different story.
One more layer to the pile.
Just one card left in the wings.
A fitting end to the count.

scenes.name: The Felt Unfolds

beats.visual: The ink-blue felt darkens slightly. Only legally revealed hole cards and community cards remain face-up; mucked hands stay hidden.
Warm-paper outlines trace evaluated combinations using only publicly revealed cards and suits.
Separate paper tabs unfold for the main pot and each actual side pot. Stationary chip tokens identify sections.
Each tab receives its actual recipients, awarded amounts and split shares; mint underlines settle into a static layout.

scenes.postAnimationResult: Hold each resolved pot outcome and public showdown cards for 7500ms. Never merge distinct main-pot and side-pot winners.
scenes.reducedMotionAlternative: Show the completed static showdown immediately, with separate labeled pots and revealed cards.

scenes.name: The Velvet Ledger

beats.visual: Authorized showdown cards settle on ink-blue felt, warm paper edges casting shallow flat shadows. Fixed camera.
A coral line sketches a ruled ledger with a separate section for every resolved pot and side pot.
Each pot section receives only its verified winner or co-winner portrait frames. Chip tokens stay beside their actual pot totals.
The ledger becomes the existing result panel, showing individual pot allocations, splits, and hand rankings.

scenes.reducedMotionAlternative: Show the authorized cards and static per-pot ledger immediately, with a seven-second result hold.

scenes.name: Quiet Constellation

beats.visual: Tiny low-contrast suit symbols appear around the ink-blue table perimeter; cards and portraits stay fixed.
Fine dots connect into a decorative arc above the publicly revealed community cards, never implying hidden holdings.
The arc divides into independent pot frames beside stationary chip-token illustrations.
Resolved recipients and amounts appear separately for each pot; dotted mint and violet accents become still.

scenes.postAnimationResult: Hold all independently resolved pots, split recipients and official amounts for 7500ms.
scenes.reducedMotionAlternative: Show resolved pot frames immediately with a static border of small suit symbols.

scenes.name: The Red Thread

beats.visual: After a completed challenge, publicly exposed disputed cards appear beside the challenged rank.
A thin coral line traces from the claim label to the exposed contradictory evidence.
The thread curls into a small question mark; the existing animal portrait frame tilts two pixels.
The mark settles beside a 'Bluff caught' verdict; exposed cards remain unobstructed.

scenes.postAnimationResult: Keep the claim, public evidence and existing rule-determined challenge result readable for 7000ms.
scenes.reducedMotionAlternative: Show the cards, verdict and stationary coral-thread illustration at once.

scenes.name: The Wobbly Seal

beats.visual: A hand-cut coral seal with the public rank sits above the challenged cards.
Authorized cards are revealed; the verified mismatch makes the seal tilt gently eight degrees.
beats.audio: Soft card flip and hollow pluck.

beats.visual: One seal corner peels upward to reveal a small ink question mark without obscuring the evidence.
The seal rests beside the challenge result panel; exposed faces remain fully readable.

scenes.reducedMotionAlternative: Keep the seal statically tilted beside the authorized revealed cards and result.

scenes.name: The Ink Blot

beats.visual: Exposed challenge cards rest in a warm-paper tray below the challenged rank.
A tiny coral blot grows in the empty margin, clear of ranks and suit marks.
The blot forms a hand-inked magnifying glass pointed at publicly revealed contradictory evidence.
The magnifier shrinks into static art; a verdict strip shows the actual challenge resolution.

scenes.postAnimationResult: Keep claim, public evidence and challenge outcome readable for 7000ms without obscuring card ranks.
scenes.reducedMotionAlternative: Show a stationary magnifier illustration and the finished evidence panel.

scenes.name: The Mint Seal

beats.visual: After a completed challenge verifies the claim, exposed cards remain face-up beside the original rank.
A thin mint circle draws in an empty seal space beside the claim.
A paper leaf settles into the seal, followed by a compact 'Verified' label.
The seal becomes still; the claimant's existing portrait frame gains a mint outline.

scenes.postAnimationResult: Hold verified rank, exposed cards and actual challenge outcome for 7500ms; never trigger on an unchallenged claim.
scenes.reducedMotionAlternative: Show the exposed evidence and static mint verification seal immediately.

scenes.name: The Paper Receipt

beats.visual: A narrow ruled paper slip slides below the authorized revealed cards, with no paragraph text.
The slip compares the public claimed rank with its verified match; two mint ink dots appear.
The slip folds once across a simple horizontal crease, displaying a mint check symbol.
The folded receipt rests next to the honest-claim result; cards and claimed rank stay unobstructed.

scenes.reducedMotionAlternative: Show the unfolded static comparison slip and revealed evidence with the final result.

scenes.name: The Truth Garden

beats.visual: Authorized revealed cards appear; a mint ink line underlines the public claim seal.
Three small mint leaves unfold from the underline like flat bookplate ornaments.
A static hand-inked hedgehog illustration appears in a small portrait-style border frame, without rigging.
Leaves stop moving and border the honest-claim result, leaving the verified evidence clear.

scenes.reducedMotionAlternative: Show the full mint ornament, static hedgehog and authorized cards with the result.

scenes.name: The Color Ribbon

beats.visual: Only after verified game completion, the last publicly played card rests on ink-blue felt. Its actual face and color remain unchanged.
Four thin strips of coral, mint, violet and pale gold unfold from beneath the card like flat paper ribbons.
Ribbons curve into an oval without covering the card. The winner portrait frame receives a matching paper border.
Ribbons rest against the felt; verified winner and final game result appear beneath the card.

scenes.reducedMotionAlternative: Show the final public card, static ribbon border and verified result without movement.

scenes.name: The Folded Corners

beats.visual: The verified final card stands upright on a warm-paper mat with four colored corner decorations outside its face.
Decorative corners fold inward a few pixels in one smooth simultaneous movement, with no flashes.
A violet line draws a scalloped border around the winner's existing hand-inked animal portrait frame.
The corner decorations stop; final card and verified winner result remain centered and legible.

scenes.reducedMotionAlternative: Display the final card, already-folded corners, winner portrait and result statically.

scenes.name: The Sleeping Palette

beats.visual: Four small flat ink puddles occupy the corners of the resolved tableau; the final public card stays still at center.
The ink puddles contract into clean circular dots, as though soaking into textured paper.
Dots arrange into a decorative diamond beside the verified winner portrait; other players' cards and portraits remain unchanged.
The diamond stops. The existing result panel expands into the cleared center area without masking the last card.

scenes.reducedMotionAlternative: Show the four-dot diamond, static final card and verified winner result.

scenes.name: The Paper Laurel

beats.visual: Resolved scores fill a warm-paper result sheet against ink-blue felt. All verified winner portraits appear, including ties.
Two thin mint laurel branches draw around every winner portrait frame, like bookplate illustrations.
Small paper leaves unfold. All portrait frames stay stationary; losing portraits do not dim or vanish.
The laurel becomes a static margin; actual winners and scores remain unobstructed.

scenes.reducedMotionAlternative: Show a static result sheet with mint laurel borders around all confirmed winners.

scenes.name: The Ink Constellation

beats.visual: A resolved result sheet displays pale-violet ink dots above the verified winner portrait frames.
Thin hand-drawn lines join the dots into geometric constellations, with constant low brightness and no flashes.
A tiny flat paper moon softly appears beside each constellation; all elements remain decorative.
Constellations become faint static ornaments. Scores and winner names retain visual priority.

scenes.reducedMotionAlternative: Display faint static constellations above each confirmed winner portrait with all results visible.

scenes.name: The Little Bookmark

beats.visual: Verified round results occupy a warm-paper folio on ink-blue felt, surrounded by existing animal portrait frames.
A fibrous coral bookmark with a triangular notch slides beside the result heading.
A tiny hand-inked animal paw print decorates the bookmark; it belongs to no player.
The bookmark rests on the page. Verified winners, ties and scores stay clear; cards and chips never move.

scenes.reducedMotionAlternative: Show the complete result folio with the coral bookmark and paw-print ornament already in place.
